description: This file defines an interface 'CipherMethod' in the namespace 'Aws\Crypto\Cipher', outlining methods for cryptographic cipher operations such as obtaining cipher names, managing IVs, padding requirements, seeking within the stream, and updating internal state based on ciphertext.

classes.name: CipherMethod
classes.description: Interface defining the methods required for cipher algorithms used in AWS cryptography operations.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an identifier recognizable by `openssl_*` functions, such as 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES-recognizable name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the Initialization Vector (IV) to be used for encrypting or decrypting the next block.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates whether the cipher method requires padding for the final block.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Adjusts the IV based on a seek operation within the encryption stream.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the internal state of the IV based on the last ciphertext block.
